description_en: You can invoke ReadyForService to make a specified agent under a specified instance ready. After becoming ready, the agent enters the idle status
description_zh: 调用ReadyForService使指定实例下的指定坐席就绪，就绪后坐席进入空闲状态
kebab_example: aliyun ccc ready-for-service --instance-id ccc-test --user-id user-test@ccc-test --device-id device --outbound-scenario false --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReadyForService

parameters.help_en: Agent ID. If not specified, it defaults to the agent mapped to the current RAM account
parameters.help_zh: 坐席ID，不填默认为当前RAM账户映射的坐席
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en: Device ID. This parameter is meaningless and can be filled with any value
parameters.help_zh: 设备ID，无意义，可以随便填写
parameters.name: device_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enter outbound-only mode after being published. This parameter is optional and defaults to false
parameters.help_zh: 上线后是否进入仅外呼模式，选填，默认false
parameters.name: outbound_scenario
